title: Incident Insights tile: hybrid aggregation window misalignment causing missing tenant metrics
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Summary: Multiple customers reported zeroed or missing tiles in the Incident Insights and Live Panels during a cross-region incident on 2026-02-18. Missing data affected both Hosted tenants and a subset of Dedicated customers behind the hybrid ingest path. Surface: tiles showed 'no data' for short windows (1m/5m) while raw traces and underlying metric series existed in the store; cross-linking between traces and metric tiles was broken for ~45 minutes for affected tenants. This ticket tracks the triage, root-cause, fix, and rollout for the remediation and backfill.
repro_steps: 1) Use a tenant with both Hosted and Dedicated ingestion routes (tenant test-hybrid-17). 2) Trigger load spike with synthetic traffic generator (scripts/ingest-stress) at t=0. 3) Observe aggregator logs (agg-0/agg-1) and the UI Live Panel tile for the 1m window. 4) Recreate by toggling the 'hybrid routing' feature flag so traffic splits 60/40 between new aggregator and legacy aggregator. Expected: tile shows continuous metrics; Observed: intermittent 'no data' periods and trace links missing. Note: not every run reproduces; reproduction is sensitive to interleaving and timing of shard watermark updates.
root_cause: During the incident we introduced a new hybrid-aggregator path (soft rollout) that aligns window boundaries using a new watermarking algorithm. Under sustained load the new aligner sometimes missed the final commit for partially-filled windows when a shard moved ownership (auto-rebalance). That left the UI queries to the time-series index with half-committed buckets. The UI layer treats those as tombstoned/absent and collapses tiles to 'no data'. Additionally, trace->metric stitch keys were derived from ephemeral sequence tokens that were not propagated during the ownership transfer, leading to broken trace links. Two causal issues: (1) window commit race on shard handoff, (2) missing propagation of sequence tokens across aggregator replicas.
fix_summary: 1) Immediate hotfix: change the window commit to use a two-phase durable checkpoint during shard handoff (PR#7254) to ensure partially-filled buckets are committed before ownership transfer completes. 2) Sequence token propagation: include last-seen seq token in the shard transfer payload and store it in the KV meta (PR#7256). 3) UI resilience: make Live Panels treat partially committed windows as 'degraded' instead of 'no data' so customers see last-known values while backfill runs. 4) Backfill job: ad-hoc reconciliation job (jobs/reconcile-hybrid-windows) to reconstruct and re-ingest any half-committed buckets for affected tenants.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for two-phase commit logic (agg/commit_test.go).
- Integration test that simulates shard handoff with injected flakiness in CI (integration/agg_shard_handoff_flaky_test).
- E2E harness that runs the synthetic traffic generator and asserts Live Panel continuity.
- Canary rollout to 3 internal tenants then 5 low-traffic external tenants (metrics collection and alerting enabled).
- Add observability checks: a) alert for increased window-commit-latency, b) metric for 'partial-window-count' and c) trace->metric-stitch-failure-rate.
deploy_plan: 1) Merge PR#7254 and PR#7256 to staging. 2) Run a staging smoke with the e2e harness for 2 hours. 3) Canary to internal staging tenants (canary-1/2/3) for 45m. 4) Canary to 5 external beta tenants (off-peak) for 1h with rollback window. 5) Gradual rollout to 30% of production traffic for 2h, then 100% if no regressions. Coordinate with infra team to avoid concurrent rebalances. Rollout windows: 0200-0600 UTC to minimize customer impact.
rollback_plan: If partial-window errors or increase in 'stitch-failure-rate' exceed threshold (≥3x baseline) during canary, rollback to previous aggregator revision and re-enable legacy routing for affected tenants. Rollback steps: 1) Toggle routing feature flag to route traffic off hybrid path, 2) revert deployment, 3) re-run reconcile job if needed. Communication: incident channel #ops-incident and paging to on-call SRE.
